title: stachys recta subsp. arenariiformis
intro: Stachys recta subsp. arenariiformis, commonly known as Narrow-leafed Woundwort, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the mint family. This plant has been traditionally used for its potential health benefits, including wound healing, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe and protect the skin. The therapeutic actions of Stachys recta subsp. arenariiformis include antiseptic, antibacterial, and anti-inflammatory activities, which contribute to its wound-healing properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and diterpenes, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
